reuse.why: The check is added to link.assertBankAccountNotLinked, the existing pre-link guard every provider's link handler in accounts/app.ts already calls before touching anything.

duplication.why: No logic is copied across providers; the only overlap is a second lookup of the upgrading account that each handler also fetches afterwards.

placement.why: The link-precondition module is the right layer, though folding a closed-account rule into a function named assertBankAccountNotLinked stretches its name rather than adding a sibling guard.

scope.why: Only the guard, its doc comment and tests change.

maintainability.why: One small, central check that all six providers inherit; the misleading function name is the main cost for a future reader.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every provider still goes through assertBankAccountNotLinked, which now carries the rule.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked, called by all link handlers in server/accounts/app.ts.
